notes.title: Multiplayer Cameo Levels OUT NOW + Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're back with the final batch of Multiplayer levels.

That's right! Starting now, you can jump into ALL of Funko Fusion's multiplayer levels, including the Cameo Levels!

We're thrilled to finally have all the of the levels available for you and your friends to jump in and cause some chaos together.

On top of that, we've also added Blacklight Skins for most of the base game characters that didn't have them previously! These can be purchased in-game using Funcoins!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update #1 - Less Hard, Faster, Better, Stronger
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for all the feedback since launch! With your help, we were able to quickly identify and fix some of the technical issues and bugs that popped up, and we are on the constant lookout for new bugs to squash as they get reported.

We’ve also heard you loud and clear that you want to have more fun playing Funko Fusion, so this is our first of several major updates with changes that will improve your experience.

In this update, we are making changes that will allow you to access Worlds and characters much faster than before, and we are reducing some of the stress of combat by re-balancing enemy and boss encounters across various levels.

First of all, Worlds can now be unlocked much faster! Players can now move onto a new World after completing one level, instead of previously needing to complete every level in a World. Completing one level in any World will also unlock all of that World’s base characters. You can now also use any unlocked character in any level immediately, breaking canon and mashing up franchises from the get-go!

Second, our goal has always been for you to have FUN, and we feel like we missed the mark at launch. As such, we are going back through the entire game, using community feedback as our guide, to re-balance combat and pacing to remove any unintended frustrations. In this Quality of Life update, you’ll notice we’ve made the effort to reduce excessive enemy spawning and, overall reduce the amount of enemies that could lead to you being overwhelmed in various parts of the game. Combat should be challenging at times, but never frustrating! We’ve also made changes that reduce backtracking throughout the game and reduce chances of you running into soft locks. 

As we’re making these changes, we love to keep hearing about things that you like, and things that you don’t. We will continue working on Quality of Life updates that improve the flow and pacing, increase the fun factor of the game, and remove anything that stands in the way of you, our players, having fun, which is the most important part of this journey! Alongside these changes we are hard at work on Co-Op mode which will also benefit from all these changes.



Patch Notes

Gameplay Adjustments

GLOBAL

 After completing the tutorial intro level, players can now select and play as any unlocked character in Story Mode by using the Golden Pop! character selection box inside any level, or via the Golden Pop! boxes in the Hub after completing the first level. Inside any level, melee the Character Pop! Box to cycle to the Golden Pop! Box and then select your character of choice.
 Players can now unlock all four base characters of a World by completing the first level of that World.
 Players can now unlock the second World for only one Golden Crown, earned by completing one level. The cost for unlocking the second World Door has been reduced to two Golden Crowns, and so forth.
 Hub flow has been adjusted to direct new players to unlock a second World after finishing the first level of the first World.
 Crown Buy Machines in levels now require less vinyl to produce a Silver Crown. Spend the vinyl freely on items and Golden Chests and experiment with random weapons and gadget combinations!
 Players are no longer interrupted by hits or shots when drinking a Soda.
 Increased the speed of drinking a Soda buff.
 Players are now invulnerable while using CCTV monitors.
 Players are now invulnerable while using Mould Machines.
 Increased player lives from 3 to 5.
 Added additional save data redundancy to prevent save game data loss from occurring.
 Adjusted text when a player is a ghost to better inform them to proceed to a Pop! Box.
 Reduced sprinting stamina cost by half, allowing Players to sprint twice as long.
 Added green crosses to the heart pickup for better visual clarity.
 Adjusted the brightness of hologram locations for items the player needs to place to help draw attention to them.
 Adjusted the UI for level screens so that the Cameo IP can be more easily seen and help players see where the Cameo levels are in the game.


WORLDS

 Rebalanced the Zombie Foxxo boss fight.


Masters of the Universe

Rebalanced the entire encounter.

 Rebalanced the entire level.

Level 3 - Vegan and Again

The Thing

Level 2 - Bark In The Dark

Level 3 - Blood Hounded

Level 5 - Blair Scare

Final Boss

 Limited the number of enemies present and disabled constant respawning of enemies.
 Rebalanced health to improve the boss encounter flow.
 Changed the number of Gold Crowns needed to access the final boss fight to 35, down from 45.


CAMEO LEVELS & CAMEO QUESTS

 Rebalanced zombie encounter outside the Winchester Pub.

M3GAN

 Enemies now jump-attack less frequently.


The Mummy

Bug Fixes

GLOBAL

regardless of the total numbers of lives they have left.

notes.title: Funko Fusion - Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here is our first update for Funko Fusion! 

It's been a blast seeing people jump into Funko Fusion for the first time!

While we love seeing you have a good time, we've also seen your bug reports and want to assure you we are working hard to address those as soon possible. In the spirit of that commitment, here is our first small update.

Patch Notes

Fixed an issue causing DLC characters to be unavailable.
Fixed an issue causing players to get stuck at Mould Machines.
Fixed an issue preventing players from unlocking Hammond after collecting 42 fossils.
Fixed various crashing/instability issues.


We're also aware of the issue causing a large number of Achievements to unlock before you actually complete them. We're working diligently to get this issue resolved. When it's ready to go live, it will correctly award the Achievements you have actually unlocked, and will lock the ones you have not earned!

If you run into other issues, you're always welcome to post in the Steam forums or in our official  Discord .

Thank you for the support thus far!

notes.title: Global Launch Time, Steam Deck Update, And More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Funko Fusion launches TOMORROW, September 13th! Here at 10:10 Games we’re excited to finally get the game in your hands! Check out the map below to find out what time the game launches in your region:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095158/a7feec63430ff30505606b2379ed70ac3d0cf758.jpg

Last Call For Pre-Orders!

As a part of the launch celebration, Players who pre-purchase Funko Fusion will receive The Walking Dead Pack for free!

The Walking Dead Pack features:
- Rick Grimes playable character.
- Rick Grimes "Leader" variant outfit.
- Michonne playable character.
- Michonne "Traveler" variant outfit.

If you're holding off on purchasing the game, no worries! The Walking Dead Pack will be also available for purchase after the pre-order period.

Don't forget, all Funko Fusion Players on Steam can also claim the the Team Fortress 2 Pack for FREE!

You've Been Promoted To Colonel!

In case you missed it, we've announced that KFC Colonel Sanders has joined the Funko Fusion roster and will be unlockable for all players at launch via an in-game mission!

[previewyoutube=DyfgskECXYQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Deck Update!

We've seen feedback from Steam Deck players who are eager to jump into our festival of fandom as well, and for that, we're incredibly thankful! We have Steam Deck fans in our studio as well.
Funko Fusion will not be officially supported on Steam Deck at launch, but we will be working to optimize the game for Steam Deck post-launch. We don't have an exact date for you just yet, but rest assured that we want to welcome Steam Deck players into the worlds of Funko Fusion with a great experience on Deck!

Thank you Steam Deck community!

That's all for now! We're looking forward to launching Funko Fusion tomorrow and we can't wait to invite you into the Wonder Works Factory for the first time!

- The 10:10 Games Team

notes.title: Developer Update - Launch, Co-Op, and Beyond
notes.notes:
As we are preparing for the launch of Funko Fusion, we want to provide an update from our development team at 10:10 Games about online co-op, what to expect at launch, and beyond.

Funko Fusion will launch September 13th on Steam with the full single-player experience!

While the team is working hard on polishing online co-op, we will release a series of post-launch updates that include free bonus characters and outfits, and will enable co-op world by world starting with Jurassic World in October and all worlds available for co-op play in November.
